news.headline: China says it will pump $54 billion into banks and insurers — but their stocks still fell
news.summary: China announced a $54 billion capital injection into banks and insurers to strengthen their balance sheets, but equities still declined as markets weighed potential new obligations on financial institutions. Analysts suggest the move could pressure firms to more actively mobilize resources across capital markets.

news.headline: Polish prosecutors charge suspect in Zondacrypto probe, seek pretrial detention
news.summary: Polish prosecutors have charged a suspect in connection with the Zondacrypto case, alleging organized crime and misappropriation of user funds. The investigation centers on roughly $2.1M in missing customer assets from the crypto platform.

educational.title: Index Funds vs. Picking Individual Stocks
points: An index fund buys a whole market segment at once — instant diversification
Most professional stock-pickers underperform simple index funds over time
Individual stocks can outperform, but concentrate your risk in one company
Index investing trades excitement for consistency and much lower fees
A common approach: index funds as the base, individual picks as a smaller side bet
